gates.name: The pull request is tied to a refined issue, and a data-model change has an ADR for that story
gates.checks: It finds the story key in the branch, title, body or closing issues, and reads the issue with `gh`. It checks that the issue has the refined label, and that a data-model change has an ADR for the story. Exit 2 means `gh` or its token is missing, and exit 3 means there is no pull request context.
gates.fix: Name an issue with the refined label in the branch, the title or the body, and add an ADR for a data-model change.

gates.name: Each issue that an ADR names points back at that ADR
gates.checks: It reads the `story:` key of each ADR, reads the issue body with `gh`, and warns when the body does not mention the ADR. It runs only in GitHub Actions with a token. Exit 2 means no issue body could be read, and exit 3 means no ADR names a story or the run is not GitHub Actions.
gates.fix: Add the ADR to the Decisions and ADRs section of the issue body, and quote the story key in the ADR front matter.
